reviews.review:
Make no mistakes; Warframe is a game all about grinding. 
If you play Warframe then grinding is what you will spend most of your time doing. If you play Warframe there will be days where RNG grants you no progress towards your next goal. 
If you play Warframe there will be nights where you cry yourself to sleep because a pub kept running off on survival and messing up the mob spawns, there will be days that you shout and rage into your monitor because somebody activated and kill you with the lasers on a defense mission.
And if you play Warframe there will be times where you sink into your chair and wish the world would just swallow you up after you realize that your shiny new weapon you spent hours grinding for is no longer fashionable having been nerfed to the ground or eclipsed by a newer superior version thats been released.

But if you keep playing Warframe through the disapointment then you'll find that there really is quite a gem of a game here. Even for all its flaws.
This is an awesome game. Nuff said.

While I haven't spent much time on the pc versio as to I didn't have a good pc. I have spent 466+ hours on the Xbox Version and I will always recomend this game, because it is just flat out amazing.
Me and friends at launch break.
Friend: Do you have Nyx Prime Helmet?
Me: No, but we can do T2 MD to farm for it.
Some Uknown amount Hours Laters
Friend: Thats our 20th Run and still no luck.
Me: The Game must hate you right now.
He at one point trades for it.
Saryn Prime Release
Friend does 11 runs of T3 Ext and 13 runs of T1 MD and no luck.
I get back on and we do 8 runs of T1 MD get it. 1 run of T2 Ext get part.
3 T3 Ext no luck. 2 T4 Ext and get her BP. 1 40min run of T3 Sur and got last part.
That was awesome cause that was all on the day they released her and grinded so cause she's MY Fav. My Friend just wants all the female Warframes.
Only Problem is game crashing after Long runs on T3 and T4 Def and Sur. :( All those good Items I should of owned.
9/10 ~ Will play more.

Really nice game. As newby as I am you are fast in and experience really amazing fights.

+ Graphic are fine
+ Graphic engine is very fast
+ Levels are large and interesting
+ There is more then fight to be done 
+ Advancement of the character (warframe) makes fun
+ Multiplayer is fast and funny

Only thing that I am missing is a bit more of dokumentation on how you can get inventory stuff. Honestly it seems you can get everything without paying, only challange is to find out how. :-)

For other Newbies like me, just give it a try!

Adjustment after several days of play:
- very repititive
- Gets more difficult adding invulnerable enemies with one-hits

I'll suggest you don't invest money...
